title: The Basics
summary: Move the view, pick your soldiers, march them, fight, and use the command card, the minimap and control groups. The controls are the same for every faction.
learn: The command card and its keys

say: Welcome, recruit. I am Sergeant Holt, and I will teach you to command.

say.pc: First, look around. Push the mouse to an edge of the screen, use the arrow keys, or hold the middle button and drag.
say.phone: First, look around. Drag the map with two fingers.

task.pc: Move the view (screen edge, arrow keys or middle button).
task.phone: Move the view (drag with two fingers).

say.pc: Good. Now roll the mouse wheel to zoom in and out.
say.phone: Good. Now pinch with two fingers to zoom in and out.

say.pc: These are your Musketeers. Click one to select it.
say.phone: These are your Musketeers. Tap one to select it.

say.pc: Now take them all: hold the left button and drag a box round them. A double-click picks every one of that kind on screen.
say.phone: Now take them all: double-tap one to pick every Musketeer on screen.

say.pc: March! Right-click the ground by the gold ring to move them there.
say.phone: March! Tap the ground by the gold ring to move them there.

steps.task: Move your Musketeers to the gold ring.

say: Bandits, over there! Shooters fire by themselves when an enemy comes in range.

say.pc: Right-click an enemy to attack it. Or press A, then click a spot: they attack everything on the way.
say.phone: Tap an enemy to attack it. Or tap ATTACK on the card, then a spot: they attack everything on the way.

say.pc: Well shot. The command card, bottom right, holds every order for what you selected. Each button has a key: hover it to see. Press HOLD, or H.
say.phone: Well shot. The command card, bottom right, holds every order for what you selected. Tap HOLD.

say: Holding men stay where they stand and shoot what comes.

task.pc: Select your Musketeers and press HOLD (H).
task.phone: Select your Musketeers and tap HOLD.

say.pc: The minimap shows the whole map. Click it to jump the view there.
say.phone: The minimap shows the whole map. Tap it to jump the view there.

say.pc: Last, control groups. Select your Musketeers and press Ctrl+1: they become group 1.
say.phone: Last, control groups. Select your Musketeers, then hold the 1 on the bar above the card: they become group 1.

task.pc: Select your Musketeers and press Ctrl+1.
task.phone: Select your Musketeers and hold the 1 on the bar.

say.pc: Now press 1 to pick the group again, from anywhere. Press it twice to jump the view to them.
say.phone: Now tap the 1 to pick the group again, from anywhere. Tap it twice to jump the view to them.

say: That is the basics, recruit. Every faction is commanded the same way.
Next, learn a faction: the Crown, the Clockwork or the Brood.

you.text: You can move the view, select, march, fight and use the card, the minimap and control groups.
